### What does this PR do?

Follow up https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8287, add SGLang online weight refit for MXFP8, routed-expert MXFP4, and routed-expert NVFP4 rollouts. The trainer exports pre-quantized checkpoint tensors, while a bucket-aware SGLang custom loader stages canonical checkpoint layouts and rebuilds backend-specific kernel layouts after the final sync bucket without replacing CUDA-graph-captured storage.

The implementation:

- translates an all-MXFP8 compressed-tensors rollout configuration to SGLang's native `quant_method: mxfp8` schema and exports `weight_scale_inv`;
- supports BF16 dense layers with MXFP4×MXFP8 or NVFP4 W4A4 routed experts;
- stages MXFP8 scales and MXFP4/NVFP4 expert tensors across all weight-sync buckets, then reprocesses them once after the final bucket;
- restores live storage if loading or post-processing fails;
- pins validated FP8/MXFP8/MXFP4 SGLang paths to DeepGEMM while leaving NVFP4 backend selection to SGLang;
- rejects the unsupported SGLang combination `linear=MXFP8, moe=MXFP4`;
- rejects `delta_flush` for custom quantized refit because finalization requires the complete bucket sequence;
- documents configuration, backend constraints, support status, and measured trainer–rollout mismatch.

This PR overlaps with [#8130](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8130) on SGLang MXFP8 export and refit. The additional scope here is a unified refit lifecycle shared by MXFP8, MXFP4, and NVFP4, including FP4 checkpoint-layout staging, backend-specific in-place reconstruction, and Blackwell validation for all three formats. It also overlaps conceptually with [#7971](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/7971), but that PR implements native NVFP4 training and vLLM rollout; this PR adds the SGLang NVFP4 refit path.

AI assistance was used for implementation review, debugging, and preparation of this PR description. The human submitter must review every changed line and confirm the validation results before submission.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs: [SGLang QAT](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+sglang+qat), [SGLang MXFP4](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+sglang+mxfp4), and [SGLang weight refit](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+sglang+weight+refit).
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`.

### Test

The mismatch measurements below use Qwen3.5-35B-A3B with Megatron EP=8, SGLang rollout TP=2, Blackwell, and the default CUDA Graph configuration:

| Rollout | Backend | `k3_kl` without QAT | `k3_kl` with matching QAT |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| MXFP8 linear + MoE | DeepGEMM linear + MoE | 0.00324 | 0.00327 |
| BF16 linear + MXFP4 MoE | DeepGEMM MoE | 0.00571 | 0.00200 |
| BF16 linear + NVFP4 MoE | FlashInfer CUTLASS MoE | 0.00946 | 0.00653 |

Local checks performed while preparing the branch:

```bash
python -m compileall -q verl/utils/sglang/sglang_quant_utils.py
git diff --check
```

The SGLang CPU test suite could not be completed in the current environment because importing `torchcodec` failed to resolve `libc10_cuda.so`. The final branch currently does not add committed unit tests; reviewers should treat the Blackwell measurements above as the available validation and require focused CPU coverage if needed.

### API and Usage Example

All-MXFP8 rollout:

```yaml
actor_rollout_ref:
  rollout:
    name: sglang
    quantization:
      linear: MXFP8
      moe: MXFP8
      ignore:
        - "re:.*linear_attn\\.in_proj_[ab]$"
  actor:
    megatron:
      qat:
        enable: true
        mode: mxfp8
        ignore_patterns:
          - "*linear_attn.in_proj_a"
          - "*linear_attn.in_proj_b"
```

MXFP4 routed experts with BF16 dense layers:

```yaml
actor_rollout_ref:
  rollout:
    name: sglang
    quantization:
      linear: null
      moe: MXFP4
  actor:
    megatron:
      qat:
        enable: true
        mode: mxfp4
```

NVFP4 routed experts with BF16 dense layers:

```yaml
actor_rollout_ref:
  rollout:
    name: sglang
    quantization:
      linear: null
      moe: NVFP4
  actor:
    megatron:
      qat:
        enable: true
        mode: nvfp4
```

SGLang intentionally rejects `linear: MXFP8` together with `moe: MXFP4`. Use BF16 dense layers for SGLang MXFP4 rollout, or use vLLM for the mixed MXFP8-linear + MXFP4-MoE configuration.

### Design & Code Changes

- `verl/utils/sglang/sglang_quant_utils.py`
  - resolves native and override quantization configurations;
  - translates all-MXFP8 compressed-tensors configurations to native SGLang MXFP8;
  - selects the required refit kind and registers one custom loader;
  - stages each bucket and sends a final marker to trigger post-load reconstruction;
  - fails fast for unsupported mixed MXFP8-linear + MXFP4-MoE rollout.
- `verl/utils/sglang/sglang_fp8_utils.py`
  - rebuilds dense MXFP8 derived scale layouts;
  - stages canonical MoE scales and folds rebuilt layouts into captured storage.
- `verl/utils/sglang/sglang_fp4_utils.py`
  - stages MXFP4 and NVFP4 expert checkpoint tensors;
  - publishes packed-weight aliases expected by SGLang loaders;
  - rebuilds backend layouts and preserves CUDA Graph storage.
- `verl/utils/qat/compressed_tensors.py`
  - detects all-MXFP8 compressed-tensors configurations;
  - selects an SGLang-specific MXFP8 exporter that emits native scale names.
- `verl/workers/rollout/sglang_rollout/async_sglang_server.py`
  - prepares the effective SGLang quantization configuration;
  - registers the refit loader and validated GEMM backends.
- `verl/workers/rollout/sglang_rollout/sglang_rollout.py`
  - uses the custom loader for every bucket;
  - sends finalization after the last bucket;
  - rejects the incompatible `delta_flush` wire format.
- `docs/low_precision/qat.md`
  - documents the support matrix, configuration, engine constraints, mismatch measurements, and limitations.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Apply [pre-commit checks](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-linting-and-formatting): `pre-commit install && pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure --color=always`.
- [x] Add / Update [the documentation](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/docs).
- [ ] Add unit or end-to-end test(s) to the CI workflow. Focused tests were developed during the branch history but are not present in the final diff; the current evidence is the Blackwell mismatch validation above.
- [ ] Once the PR is ready for CI, send a message in the `ci-request` channel.
- [x] This PR is not related to the `recipe` submodule.

### What does this PR do?

Follow up https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8287, add SGLang online weight refit for MXFP8, routed-expert MXFP4, and routed-expert NVFP4 rollouts. The trainer exports pre-quantized checkpoint tensors, while a bucket-aware SGLang custom loader stages canonical checkpoint layouts and rebuilds backend-specific kernel layouts after the final sync bucket without replacing CUDA-graph-captured storage.

The implementation:

- translates an all-MXFP8 compressed-tensors rollout configuration to SGLang's native `quant_method: mxfp8` schema and exports `weight_scale_inv`;
- supports BF16 dense layers with MXFP4×MXFP8 or NVFP4 W4A4 routed experts;
- stages MXFP8 scales and MXFP4/NVFP4 expert tensors across all weight-sync buckets, then reprocesses them once after the final bucket;
- restores live storage if loading or post-processing fails;
- pins validated FP8/MXFP8/MXFP4 SGLang paths to DeepGEMM while leaving NVFP4 backend selection to SGLang;
- rejects the unsupported SGLang combination `linear=MXFP8, moe=MXFP4`;
- rejects `delta_flush` for custom quantized refit because finalization requires the complete bucket sequence;
- documents configuration, backend constraints, support status, and measured trainer–rollout mismatch.

This PR overlaps with [#8130](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8130) on SGLang MXFP8 export and refit. The additional scope here is a unified refit lifecycle shared by MXFP8, MXFP4, and NVFP4, including FP4 checkpoint-layout staging, backend-specific in-place reconstruction, and Blackwell validation for all three formats. It also overlaps conceptually with [#7971](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/7971), but that PR implements native NVFP4 training and vLLM rollout; this PR adds the SGLang NVFP4 refit path.

AI assistance was used for implementation review, debugging, and preparation of this PR description. The human submitter must review every changed line and confirm the validation results before submission.

### Test

The mismatch measurements below use Qwen3.5-35B-A3B with Megatron EP=8, SGLang rollout TP=2, Blackwell, and the default CUDA Graph configuration:

| Rollout | Backend | `k3_kl` without QAT | `k3_kl` with matching QAT |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| MXFP8 linear + MoE | DeepGEMM linear + MoE | 0.00324 | 0.00327 |
| BF16 linear + MXFP4 MoE | DeepGEMM MoE | 0.00571 | 0.00200 |
| BF16 linear + NVFP4 MoE | FlashInfer CUTLASS MoE | 0.00946 | 0.00653 |

### API and Usage Example

All-MXFP8 rollout:

```yaml
actor_rollout_ref:
  rollout:
    name: sglang
    quantization:
      linear: MXFP8
      moe: MXFP8
      ignore:
        - "re:.*linear_attn\\.in_proj_[ab]$"
  actor:
    megatron:
      qat:
        enable: true
        mode: mxfp8
        ignore_patterns:
          - "*linear_attn.in_proj_a"
          - "*linear_attn.in_proj_b"
```

```yaml

  rollout:
    name: sglang
    quantization:
      linear: null
      moe: MXFP4
  actor:
    megatron:
      qat:
        enable: true
        mode: mxfp4
```

```yaml
actor_rollout_ref:
  rollout:
    name: sglang
    quantization:
      linear: null
      moe: NVFP4
  actor:
    megatron:
      qat:
        enable: true
        mode: nvfp4
```

SGLang intentionally rejects `linear: MXFP8` together with `moe: MXFP4`. Use BF16 dense layers for SGLang MXFP4 rollout, or use vLLM for the mixed MXFP8-linear + MXFP4-MoE configuration.

### Design & Code Changes

- `verl/utils/sglang/sglang_quant_utils.py`
  - resolves native and override quantization configurations;
  - translates all-MXFP8 compressed-tensors configurations to native SGLang MXFP8;
  - selects the required refit kind and registers one custom loader;
  - stages each bucket and sends a final marker to trigger post-load reconstruction;
  - fails fast for unsupported mixed MXFP8-linear + MXFP4-MoE rollout.
- `verl/utils/sglang/sglang_fp8_utils.py`
  - rebuilds dense MXFP8 derived scale layouts;
  - stages canonical MoE scales and folds rebuilt layouts into captured storage.
- `verl/utils/sglang/sglang_fp4_utils.py`
  - stages MXFP4 and NVFP4 expert checkpoint tensors;
  - publishes packed-weight aliases expected by SGLang loaders;
  - rebuilds backend layouts and preserves CUDA Graph storage.
- `verl/utils/qat/compressed_tensors.py`
  - detects all-MXFP8 compressed-tensors configurations;
  - selects an SGLang-specific MXFP8 exporter that emits native scale names.
- `verl/workers/rollout/sglang_rollout/async_sglang_server.py`
  - prepares the effective SGLang quantization configuration;
  - registers the refit loader and validated GEMM backends.
- `verl/workers/rollout/sglang_rollout/sglang_rollout.py`
  - uses the custom loader for every bucket;
  - sends finalization after the last bucket;
  - rejects the incompatible `delta_flush` wire format.

+def _mxfp4_checkpoint_layout(module: torch.nn.Module) -> dict[str, tuple[tuple[int, ...], torch.dtype]]:

+    qm = module.quant_method
+    experts = module.num_local_experts
+    intermediate = qm.intermediate_size_per_partition
+    hidden = qm.hidden_size

+        "w2_weight": ((experts, hidden, intermediate // 2), torch.uint8),

+"""SGLang MXFP8 staging and in-place post-load refit utilities.
+
+SGLang derives backend-specific scale layouts during model loading. Bucketed
+weight sync restores canonical scales, loads every bucket, then calls these
+helpers once to rebuild those layouts and copy them back into the storage
+captured by CUDA Graphs.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+
+MXFP8_BLOCK_SIZE = 32
+
+
+def _is_mxfp8_linear(module: torch.nn.Module) -> bool:
+    qm = getattr(module, "quant_method", None)
+    return (
+        qm is not None
+        and getattr(qm, "use_mxfp8", False)
+        and hasattr(qm, "process_weights_after_loading")
+        and hasattr(module, "weight_scale_inv")
+    )
+
+
+def _layer_backend(qm) -> tuple[object, bool]:
+    """Return ``(backend, resolved)`` for one MXFP8 quant method.
+
+    ``resolved`` is True when sglang itself resolved the MXFP8 dense backend
+    (>= 0.5.18, ``quant_method.mxfp8_dense_backend``); otherwise the requested
+    ``--fp8-gemm-backend`` is returned, where ``auto`` means Triton for MXFP8.
+    """
+    backend = getattr(qm, "mxfp8_dense_backend", None)
+    if backend is not None:
+        return backend, True
+    from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8_utils import get_fp8_gemm_runner_backend
+
+    return get_fp8_gemm_runner_backend(), False
+
+
+def _needs_reprocess(backend, resolved: bool) -> bool:
+    if backend.is_flashinfer_trtllm():
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            "MXFP8 weight sync with the flashinfer_trtllm GEMM backend is not supported: that backend "
+            "shuffles the weight tensor in place at load time, so post-load processing cannot be re-run "
+            "after a sync. Use flashinfer_cutlass / flashinfer_cutedsl, or leave the backend unset."
+        )
+    if resolved:
+        # CUTLASS, CuTe-DSL and DeepGEMM all derive their kernel layout from the canonical
+        # weight_scale_inv the sync just rewrote; re-running the processing is idempotent for
+        # them and a no-op for backends that read the canonical scale directly.
+        return True
+    # sglang <= 0.5.17: only flashinfer_cutlass keeps a derived copy; Triton (auto) reads
+    # weight_scale_inv directly.
+    return backend.is_flashinfer_cutlass()
+
+
+def reprocess_mxfp8_layers(model: torch.nn.Module) -> int:
+    """Re-derive backend-specific MXFP8 scale layouts from the canonical scales.
+
+    Returns the number of modules reprocessed. Raises for backends whose
+    post-load processing is not idempotent (``flashinfer_trtllm``).
+    """
+    count = 0
+    for name, module in model.named_modules():
+        if not _is_mxfp8_linear(module):
+            continue
+        qm = module.quant_method
+        backend, resolved = _layer_backend(qm)
+        if not _needs_reprocess(backend, resolved):
+            continue
+        if not getattr(qm, "is_checkpoint_fp8_serialized", True):
+            # Would re-quantize from a bf16 master weight that a sync just replaced with fp8 data.
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"{name}: MXFP8 quant method expects a non-fp8-serialized checkpoint; refusing to "
+                "re-quantize after a weight sync."
+            )
+        # DeepGEMM can fall back to FlashInfer for unsupported shapes. SGLang clears
+        # the fallback's swizzled scale before rebuilding it, which would otherwise
+        # rebind storage that CUDA graphs captured at startup.
+        captured = {
+            attr: value
+            for attr in ("weight_scale_inv_swizzled", "weight_scale_inv_deepgemm")
+            if isinstance((value := getattr(module, attr, None)), torch.Tensor)
+        }
+        qm.process_weights_after_loading(module)
+        for attr, live in captured.items():
+            rebuilt = getattr(module, attr, None)
+            if not isinstance(rebuilt, torch.Tensor):
+                raise RuntimeError(f"{name}.{attr}: post-load processing did not rebuild the captured scale")
+            if rebuilt.shape != live.shape or rebuilt.dtype != live.dtype:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    f"{name}.{attr}: post-load processing produced {tuple(rebuilt.shape)}/{rebuilt.dtype} but "
+                    f"CUDA graphs captured {tuple(live.shape)}/{live.dtype}"
+                )
+            if rebuilt.data_ptr() != live.data_ptr():
+                live.copy_(rebuilt)
+                setattr(module, attr, live)
+        count += 1
+    return count
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# MoE experts
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_MOE_SCALE_PAIRS = (("w13_weight", "w13_weight_scale_inv"), ("w2_weight", "w2_weight_scale_inv"))
+
+
+def _is_mxfp8_moe(module: torch.nn.Module) -> bool:
+    qm = getattr(module, "quant_method", None)
+    return (
+        qm is not None
+        and getattr(qm, "use_mxfp8", False)
+        and hasattr(qm, "process_weights_after_loading")
+        and hasattr(module, "w13_weight_scale_inv")
+    )
+
+
+def _canonical_scale_shape(weight: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    return (*tuple(weight.shape[:-1]), weight.shape[-1] // MXFP8_BLOCK_SIZE)
+
+
+def stage_mxfp8_moe_scales(model: torch.nn.Module) -> list[tuple[torch.nn.Module, str, torch.Tensor]]:
+    """Expose canonical-layout expert scale buffers so ``load_weights`` can write into them.
+
+    Returns ``(module, scale_name, live_data)`` for every expert scale whose live
+    buffer no longer has the checkpoint shape or dtype; ``reprocess_mxfp8_moe_layers``
+    folds the re-derived layout back into ``live_data``. Scales the runner rewrote
+    without changing shape or dtype (FlashInfer TRT-LLM; CUTLASS on sglang <= 0.5.15)
+    or left canonical (CUTLASS on sglang >= 0.5.20) are not staged: ``load_weights``
+    writes the canonical data over the live buffer and the re-processing rewrites it
+    in place, if at all.
+    """
+    pending = []
+    for module in model.modules():
+        if not _is_mxfp8_moe(module):
+            continue
+        for wname, sname in _MOE_SCALE_PAIRS:
+            weight = getattr(module, wname, None)
+            param = getattr(module, sname, None)
+            if weight is None or not isinstance(param, torch.nn.Parameter):
+                continue
+            canonical = _canonical_scale_shape(weight.data)
+            if tuple(param.data.shape) == canonical and param.data.dtype == torch.uint8:
+                continue
+            staging = torch.empty(canonical, dtype=torch.uint8, device=param.data.device)
+            pending.append((module, sname, param, staging))
+    # Rebind only once every staging buffer is allocated: a failed allocation must not leave a
+    # parameter on a staging buffer that no returned list records.
+    staged = []
+    for module, sname, param, staging in pending:
+        staged.append((module, sname, param.data))
+        param.data = staging
+    return staged
+
+
+def reprocess_mxfp8_moe_layers(model: torch.nn.Module, staged: list[tuple[torch.nn.Module, str, torch.Tensor]]) -> int:
+    """Re-run the MoE post-load processing and fold results into the captured storage."""
+    live_by_key = {(id(m), n): live for m, n, live in staged}
+    count = 0
+    for name, module in model.named_modules():
+        if not _is_mxfp8_moe(module):
+            continue
+        qm = module.quant_method
+        if not getattr(qm, "is_checkpoint_fp8_serialized", True):
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"{name}: MXFP8 MoE quant method expects a non-fp8-serialized checkpoint; refusing to "
+                "re-quantize experts after a weight sync."
+            )
+        qm.process_weights_after_loading(module)
+        for _, sname in _MOE_SCALE_PAIRS:
+            live = live_by_key.get((id(module), sname))
+            if live is None:
+                continue
+            param = getattr(module, sname)
+            new = param.data
+            if tuple(new.shape) != tuple(live.shape) or new.dtype != live.dtype:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    f"{name}.{sname}: post-load processing produced {tuple(new.shape)}/{new.dtype} but the live "
+                    f"buffer is {tuple(live.shape)}/{live.dtype}; the MoE runner's scale layout changed between "
+                    "load and refit and cannot be updated in place."
+                )
+            if new.data_ptr() != live.data_ptr():
+                live.copy_(new)
+            param.data = live
+        count += 1
+    # Post-condition: every staged scale is back on the storage the CUDA graph captured. A module
+    # that was staged but not visited above (predicate changed between stage and reprocess) would
+    # otherwise keep serving the staging buffer while the graph replays the stale live one.
+    for module, sname, live in staged:
+        param = getattr(module, sname)
+        if param.data.data_ptr() != live.data_ptr():
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"{type(module).__name__}.{sname}: staged for the sync but not folded back into its live "
+                "storage by reprocess_mxfp8_moe_layers; the CUDA graph would keep reading stale scales."
+            )
+    return count

+def resolve_sglang_quantization_config(config: Any, model_config: Any) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    """Return the rollout override or the model's native quantization config."""
+    quantization = getattr(config, "quantization", None)
+    if quantization is not None and quantization.enabled:
+        return quantization.build_quantization_config(model_config.local_path)

+    hf_config = model_config.hf_config
+    native = getattr(hf_config, "quantization_config", None)
+    if native is None:
+        native = getattr(getattr(hf_config, "text_config", None), "quantization_config", None)
+    if native is None:
+        return None
+    if hasattr(native, "to_dict"):
+        native = native.to_dict()
+    if not isinstance(native, Mapping):
+        raise TypeError(f"quantization_config must be a mapping, got {type(native).__name__}")
+    return dict(native)

+def _translate_ignored_layers(ignored_layers: Iterable[str]) -> list[str]:
+    translated = []
+    for ignored in ignored_layers:

+            native = _REGEX_IGNORE_TO_SGLANG.get(ignored)
+            if native is None:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"SGLang native MXFP8 does not support regex ignored layer {ignored!r}; "
+                    "use an exact module path or add an engine-name translation"
+                )
+            native_names = native if isinstance(native, tuple) else (native,)
+        else:
+            native_names = (ignored,)
+        for native_name in native_names:
+            if native_name not in translated:

+def translate_mxfp8_to_sglang_fp8_config(ct_config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Translate an all-MXFP8 compressed-tensors override to native SGLang."""

+        raise ValueError("SGLang native MXFP8 translation requires every config group to use MXFP8")
+    return {
+        "quant_method": "mxfp8",
+        "activation_scheme": "dynamic",
+        "weight_block_size": [1, 32],

+    """Return the format that needs SGLang's bucket-aware refit loader."""
